error_message.description: Why the stage did not reach 'optimized'.

failure_reason.description: The cause, on the axis the status enum deliberately does not cover.

iteration.description: Required of every outcome, not just success: the kernel-worker knows its iteration number before it does any work, so a failure can always say which iteration failed.

optimized_kernel_artifact.description: Path to the optimized kernel artifact. Owed by an 'optimized' result; absent otherwise.

status.description: What this iteration produced. 'optimized' means the iteration ended with a kernel that compiled and passed its tests. This replaces {success, failed, completed}, in which `success` and `completed` overlapped with no stated difference. 'needs_input' means the target needs a setting only the user can give, such as a `gke_job` profile with no `staging_bucket` to bring profile traces back; `error_message` carries the question and the setup command. The fields 'optimized' owes are declared in `status_requires` and enforced by the runtime, because this validator has no conditional keywords.
